papers.title: SLAI T-Rex: Full-Parameter Post-training of the DeepSeek-V4 Family on Ascend SuperPOD
papers.abstract: Full-parameter post-training of trillion-parameter-scale MoE models introduces substantial system-level challenges. We present end-to-end optimization on Ascend NPU SuperPOD, achieving 34.22% Model FLOPs Utilization with 2.93x improvement over baseline

papers.title: Self Gradient Forcing: Native Long Video Extrapolation
papers.abstract: Recent autoregressive video diffusion methods use Self Forcing, where the student trains on histories from its own rollout rather than ground-truth contexts. This reduces exposure bias but leaves a historical context-gradient gap. We propose Self Gradient Forcing (SGF)

papers.title: Beyond Relevance-Centric Retrieval: Rubric-Oriented Document Set Selection and Ranking
papers.abstract: Existing evaluation systems score documents independently via nDCG, ignoring inter-document interactions. We propose SetwiseEvalKit, a three-level benchmark with 28K evaluation rubrics, and Rubric4Setwise, a training-free method for document set optimization

papers.title: An Exam for Active Observers
papers.abstract: ActiveVision is a benchmark making active observation measurable for multimodal LLMs. Frontier models collapse on it: GPT-5.5 solves only 10.6% of items, while human participants average 96.1%, indicating current MLLMs lack robust active visual observation

papers.title: Scaling Laws for Hypernetwork-Based Knowledge Injection in Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Hypernetworks provide promising solutions for large-scale knowledge injection into LLMs. We construct MegaWikiQA dataset with tens of millions of examples, demonstrating predictive power law scaling and reliable out-of-distribution generalization at increasing scales

papers.title: Generalizable VLA Finetuning via Representation Anchoring and Language-Action Alignment
papers.abstract: Behavior cloning finetuning of vision-language models for robotics overwrites pretrained representations. We propose Anchor-Align with Vision-Language Anchoring and Language-Action Alignment, improving real-robot success from 28% to 54%

papers.title: Beyond Euclidean Clipping: Overcoming Exploration Collapse in LLM RL via Riemannian Isometric Policy Optimization
papers.abstract: PPO-Clip fundamental flaw is measuring policy discrepancy using Euclidean metrics inconsistent with policy Riemannian manifold geometry. We propose RIPO, guaranteeing isometric updates, achieving up to 60% improvement over GRPO on AIME24

papers.title: DocOps: A Verifiable Benchmark for Autonomous Agents in Complex Document Operations
papers.abstract: DocOps is a deterministically verifiable evaluation framework for document manipulation by autonomous agents. Analysis reveals three key failure modes: long-term state tracking collapse, shallow semantic verification, and destructive metadata editing

papers.title: FVAttn: Adaptive Sparse Attention with Runtime Load Balancing for Video Generation
papers.abstract: Video Diffusion Transformers face attention bottlenecks. FVAttn uses adaptive Top-p routing with runtime load balancing, achieving 4.41x attention speedup over FlashAttention and 2.02-2.11x DiT inference speedup with competitive video quality

papers.title: Trace: A Taxonomy-Guided Environment for Multidomain Visual Reasoning
papers.abstract: Trace is a taxonomy-guided environment for multidomain visual reasoning with 1,000 tasks across 277 scene grammars and 11 visual domains. RLVR on 64,000 instances improves macro-average by 3.51-4.06 percentage points across 24 external benchmarks

cc_updates.body: Changed /code-review to run as a background subagent, so review work no longer fills your conversation. Added screen-reader announcements of deleted text. Fixed Windows paths with \u-prefixed segments being corrupted into CJK characters. Fixed the left arrow key discarding the conversation with no undo. Added HTTP status and error text to claude mcp list when a server fails to connect. Fixed multi-line paste collapsing into one line. Fixed /context reporting stale pre-compact token usage. Fixed /ultrareview failing on descriptive arguments. Fixed /code-review ultra silently running a local review in non-interactive sessions.

Added emoji shortcode autocomplete in prompt input: type :heart: to insert emoji. Added warnings when transcript writes are failing. Fixed a memory leak where truncated MCP tool outputs kept the full untruncated result in memory. Fixed Windows auto-update failures that could leave claude.exe missing. Fixed auto-compact never triggering for Claude Opus 4.8 on Bedrock. Added a cap on concurrently-running subagents (default 20, override with CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONCURRENT_SUBAGENTS).

Added sandbox.filesystem.disabled setting to skip filesystem isolation while keeping network egress control. Fixed a slowdown in long sessions where message normalization cost grew quadratically with the number of turns. Fixed auto mode denying commands with HTTP 401 classifier errors after OAuth token expired. Fixed AskUserQuestion telling Claude to continue even when your answer asked it to wait. Fixed Claude Code on the web re-asking the same question and dropping your answer after the session sat idle.
